subject: Ninja
text: The Ninja has better Absorb than the Red Wizard and takes up position 2.

evidence.quote: With better Absorb than the Red Wizard, the Ninja takes up position 2.

subject: Red Wizard
text: The Red Wizard can cast Exit and Life after promotion.

evidence.quote: Red Wizard can cast Exit and Life now, making his wide ranged skills even more so.

subject: Ninja
text: The Ninja is a stronger attacker than the Thief, but is not nearly as powerful as a second Fighter or Black Belt.

evidence.quote: The Ninja will be a stronger attacker than the Thief was, but still not nearly as powerful as a second Fighter or Black Belt would have been.

subject: White Wizard
text: A team without a White Wizard cannot use the highest level White Wizard spells.

evidence.quote: No usage of the highest level White Wizard spells either.

subject: Undead
text: Undead monster groups can be defeated quickly using Fire and Harm spells.

evidence.quote: Groups of monsters can be smashed quickly, especially the undead (Fire and Harm are your friends).

subject: Red Mage
text: The Red Mage's Absorb begins to show its weakness upon reaching the Earth Cave area of the game.

evidence.quote: The Red Mages Absorb will start showing its weakness once you reach the Earth Cave area of the game.

subject: Ribbon
text: In a party of four spellcasters, one character will be unable to equip a Ribbon due to limited availability.

evidence.quote: One character will be unfortunate to not have a Ribbon available for being equipped.

subject: Red Wizard
text: Red Wizards have weaker attacks compared to a Knight and Monk, and lower defense than a Knight.

evidence.quote: Red Wizards are weak in attack compared to a Knight and Monk as well as the Knight's defense.

subject: Black Belt
text: The Black Belt can start bare hand fighting upon reaching Level 10.

evidence.quote: Add onto that how the Red mage will start to become less powerful, the Black Belt being poor until he reaches the Level 10 area (he can start bare hand fighting then), and the Thief seems useful for the sole purpose of running only, and you have a relative tough team to use.

subject: Fighter
text: The Fighter can live off of equipment found from the Marsh Cave onwards.

evidence.quote: the Fighter can live off of found equipment from the Marsh Cave onwards.

subject: Knight
text: Knights gain low level White Magic charges upon promoting from Fighter.

evidence.quote: Knights will not have changed from their Fighter origins (although they will gain some low level White Magic charges), and the same can be said for the Master and Red Wizard, but the big change is your Thief to a Ninja.

subject: Ninja
text: Upon promoting from Thief, the Ninja gains low level Black Magic including Fast, can equip top tier weaponry and armor, and deals greatly increased damage.

evidence.quote: He will have gained some low level Black Magic (including Fast), the ability to use top of the line weaponry and armor, and the damage dealt will be increased greatly.

subject: Red Wizard
text: The Red Wizard cannot learn Level 8 spells, although he can learn Exit.

evidence.quote: A lack of magic will still be an issue, especially since the Red Wizard can not learn the powerful Level 8 spells (he can learn Exit though).

subject: Black Belt
text: Black Belts are cheap to equip near the start of the game, requiring few upgrades that are mostly findable as you progress.

evidence.quote: Black Belts as always are cheaper to equip near the start, requiring little upgrades now and then (most of which is findable as you progress).

subject: Black Belt
text: Black Belts cannot deliver significant damage with consistency until Level 10, which is over 25% of the way through the game.

evidence.quote: Black Belts are not able to deliver any significant damage with any consistency till Level 10, and even then that is over 25% of the way though the game.

subject: Black Belt
text: Black Belts only require the odd Bracelet as equipment while traveling.

evidence.quote: Black Belts will require the odd Bracelet as you travel, but that will be it.

subject: Red Mage
text: Red Mages start out with no real weakness, but their growth and defense begin to waver around the Earth Cave.

evidence.quote: Red Mages have no real weakness to speak of when starting out, though their growth and defense will abruptly begin to waver around the Earth Cave.
